recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further FHIR-core work is needed for FHIR-7530; future work on the optional bindingName extension should stay with the already-audited extension-pack issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-7530 was a Published/Persuasive 2015 May FHIR-core ballot issue for FHIR-I requesting removal of ElementDefinition.binding.name and corresponding tooling changes to use the target ValueSet name or a NamingSystem-backed external source label.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records the 2015-06-10 11-0-0 vote and an application comment of 'svn revision 7530.' No Git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-7530, but git history shows the structural removal in fbaf29fb043878886a33392fb9a1017135ef9fed and a later history note in 58727a74e2a7cac67026906f355607b64bd0bf90 documenting 'remove binding.name'.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Later issues FHIR-12510 and FHIR-51990 concern the separate elementdefinition-bindingName extension, not a formal ElementDefinition.binding.name child; FHIR-51990 is already represented on the combined branch as external-repo commit 2d439b612e4e7750890cc38f922f1ad3c562254a.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml has ElementDefinition.binding, strength, description, valueSet, and additional binding rows, but no ElementDefinition.binding.name row; the only core source hit for binding.name is the version-history note that it was removed.

related_jiras.note: Another 2015 May ballot issue about showing ValueSet and strength instead of binding names; it supports the conclusion that tooling stopped using binding names as primary links.
Later approved a separate binding-name extension for generated-type/rendering metadata, distinct from the removed formal ElementDefinition.binding.name element.
Later clarified the bindingName extension wording; it is already reconciled on the combined branch as external-repo commit 2d439b612e4e7750890cc38f922f1ad3c562254a.
